description.short: Reads and writes files under three allowlisted folders.
description.full: Connects Microsoft 365 agents to the local filesystem bridge. The upstream MCP filesystem server is started with exactly three roots - the tooling folder, Downloads and the OneDrive Cowork folder - and refuses every path outside them. Writes require approval in the agent surface; nothing outside the roots is reachable.

agentConnectors.description: Lists, reads, writes, edits and moves files strictly under the three allowlisted roots passed to the filesystem server at start-up. Any path outside the roots is refused by the server itself.
